description: `name := value` (the walrus operator): assigns and returns the value inside an expression, such as a `while` header or a comprehension filter.
Inside a comprehension, `:=` binds in the enclosing function or module, not in the comprehension.
The `else` block runs when the loop ends without `break`, including when the iterable is empty.
Runs when the `try` block raised no exception; its own exceptions are not caught by the preceding `except` clauses.
`a if condition else b`: evaluates the condition first, then only the chosen branch.
